dbqueries.dbquery: UPDATE tp_applicants ta, tp_sources ts SET ta.source_id = (SELECT source_id FROM tp_sources WHERE system_generated=? LIMIT 0,1) WHERE ta.source_id = ts.source_id AND ts.system_generated!=? AND (select count(*) from tp_applicant_joining_history tajh where tajh.applicant_id=ta.applicant_id) = 0 AND ts.lock_in_period_on_import > 0 AND ts.lock_in_period_on_import is not null AND ta.resume_locked_date < DATE_SUB(now(),INTERVAL ts.lock_in_period_on_import MONTH)
